groups.operation: Parse an over-limit query through pugi::xpath_query::xpath_query.
groups.condition: The XPath query exceeds the parser depth limit.
groups.capability: Reach the depth-limit check and report its query-depth error.
groups.consequence: An over-limit query is not rejected through the expected public query behavior.
groups.equivalence_reason: Distinct from variable-set handling: this concerns query depth and error reporting.

groups.operation: Parse a variable reference through pugi::xpath_query::xpath_query.
groups.condition: The query contains a variable reference and requires a variable set.
groups.capability: Supply and forward the variable set to the parser's _variables pointer.
groups.consequence: The variable reference cannot be resolved during parsing.
groups.equivalence_reason: Distinct from depth-limit handling: this concerns supplying variables to the public query operation.
